## [0.30.0] - 2026-09-14

Vayu's accent color can now follow your operating system's own accent color on Windows and macOS.

### Added

- **A "Match system accent color" toggle in Settings > Appearance.** Turn it on and Vayu switches to whichever of its accent color schemes is closest to your OS accent color, and follows it live if you change it in system settings. Off by default, and not shown on Linux, which has no system accent color to read.
